SOUTHEAST RESOURCE RECOVERY
  FACILITY (SERRF) AGENDA

  2400 EAST SPRING ST. BLDG. 570
  ENERGY RESOURCES, 2ND FL, CONFERENCE ROOM, 4:00 PM

DIRECTORS  ALTERNATES
Kristina Duggan, Chair  Al Austin, Alternative

Robert Dowell, General Manager
Jane Hermsen, Secretary

  SPECIAL MEETING

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT EMAIL COMMENTS TO
  JANE.HERMSEN@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-55202  Recommendation to approve the minutes of the Southeast Resource Recovery
  Facility Authority meeting of Thursday, February 15, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-55203  Recommendation to authorize General Manager, or designee, to execute a
  contract, including any other necessary documents or subsequent amendments,
  with TRC Solutions, Inc. of Irvine, CA for providing regulated materials assessment,
  planning, and construction support for demolition of SERRF and file CE#24-150
  notice of exemption from the California Environmental Quality Act.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-55204  Recommendation to continue to utilize Richard Anthony as representative counsel
  for SERRF JPA as recommended by City Attorney.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  24-55241  Recommendation to authorize General Manager to execute all documents
  necessary to assume existing agreements between Covanta Long Beach and its
  vendors.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.
